item.title: Tuesday Morning, Nov 17
item.description:
The Tuesday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 17, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather with the full seven-day forecast; a CNN report on Iranian planning for a dirty bomb in Washington, what caused Monday's bank outages, and today's nationwide emergency alert test; Ukraine brings down part of the Crimean bridge as Russia hits bridges in Kyiv; President Trump at the ASEAN summit in Manila and new tanker attacks near Hormuz; futures slip ahead of Nvidia earnings as Disney and Home Depot report; Apple limits Siri's heavier AI tasks and tightens Mac permissions for AI agents; California sues OpenAI over runaway AI agents, and Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max; hijacked Optimizely code on CNN, Zoom and 176 other organizations' sites, and an Uber driver data breach; your X feed; a Lake Winnipesaukee island fire and the Lindsay Clancy retrial date; and the New Hampshire school that saved last winter's snow. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 1 PM Update, Nov 16
item.description:
The Monday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 16, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow; the Supreme Court turns away cases on university research grants and Maryland's gun-free zones; three people shot in the Bronx's Co-op City; Britain's prime minister says Brexit hasn't worked; new Iranian claims in the Strait of Hormuz; stocks slide at midday as a source says Nvidia's board isn't considering Jensen Huang's return; new US limits on remote access to AI chips and a study on data center power use; OpenAI lets outside safety testers inside; Anthropic shortens its bug disclosure deadline and AI-run hacking from a China-linked group; your X feed; Drake Maye's injury and Londonderry's budget; and a marathon moment of sportsmanship. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 10 AM Update, Nov 16
item.description:
The Monday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 16, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow; President Trump leaves for Asia and says he may meet Kim Jong Un; New York City disbands the NYPD's Strategic Response Group; Ukraine hits the Kerch bridge to Crimea; Iran's new mine claims and its refusal of nuclear inspections; stocks open lower as the push to bring back Jensen Huang grows; Microsoft explains last week's outage; AI helps decode Kurt Gödel's lost theorems; Google warns of fully automated AI hacking; your X feed; North Country housing and a loss at Concord Hospital; and why your cat meows at you. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
